results.reply: Evening, stranger. I'm Padraig Darcy, owner of this here pub. Welcome to the only game in town.
Ach, Seamus! Come in out of the rain, the pair of ye. Have ye brought word from the east?
Aye, Michael, you're just in time for the midday dram. Have you come to drown the preacher's sermon or just to keep me company?
Evening, I'm Brigid O'Brien, the midwife. You're new to the village, are you not?
Good morrow, Seamus. Did the rain not keep you from your rounds?
Good day, Seamus. Did you come for the blessing or the gossip?
Good evening. I am Father Cathal Donnellan, priest of this parish.
Good morrow, Bridget. The rain whispers of old things—will you not speak of them?
Eileen, what brings you to the church on this misty Sunday? You know the old ways are not welcome here.
Aye, I'm Sean Murphy, farmer of the bog. Hunger's a cruel master, but I'd sooner starve than let it make me short with a stranger.
